groups.rationale: No catch-all source changes; shared chapters 17, 21 and 22 changed only for the guest-native Windows custodian same-boot recovery (ADR-0237), which adds no Ash domain, host, service or deployment placement.

marshall/priv/hldd only: scenarios.json windows-browser-editor-candidate gains recorded portable property evidence for ADR-0237 recovery and an explicit native custodian-crash gap; chapters 08, 17, 19, 20, 21 and 22 describe logon-session same-boot recovery. No Marshall application code, Ash resource, route or Editor release gating changes; windows-editor-v1 stays unselected.
No protocol/ source changes; windows-editor-v1 manifest/bundle codecs and capability rows are unchanged. Shared chapters changed only for the guest-native custodian recovery mechanism of ADR-0237.

No lilly/ source changes; Lilly placement, bundle and gateway behaviour are unchanged. Shared chapters 07, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21 and 22 changed only for the in-guest Windows custodian same-boot recovery of ADR-0237.

No audi/brady/ziggy/galileo/enrico/porsche/lyra/peach source changes; Audi editor transport and Lyra roster authorizer behaviour are unchanged. Shared chapters changed only for the in-guest Windows custodian same-boot recovery of ADR-0237.

nix/domains/artifacts/vscode-web-broker: ADR-0237 same-boot custodian-crash recovery. The custodian reserves its endpoint, durably advances a per-boot generation in generation.json, scopes job/worker-pipe/version-2 receipt names by generation, records the S4U logon session, and retires an earlier generation receipt only after its job vanished and a Toolhelp snapshot shows zero processes of the exact account logon session, terminating only re-verified stragglers. Chapters 07, 08, 16 (cold-receipt table), 17, 20, 21 and 22 replace the old refuse-until-reboot text; scenario windows-browser-editor-candidate gains two recorded portable properties and names the unexecuted native crash gap. No Nix option, host, service placement or capability row changes.

docs/: new ADR-0237 (accepted, partial) with index and overview entries; ADR-0208 implementation evidence, open question and related links now point to ADR-0237 without changing its decision; the custodian review gains the 2026-10-20 recovery checkpoint with exact commands. Shared chapters 17, 19, 20, 21 and 22 reflect the same recovery boundary; no governance rule or checker changes.
